name: METAL APEX - Rogue Prototype
detailed_description:
We all knew where this would end.

We built autonomous weapons because they were inevitable; because if we didn't, someone else would. We gambled that we could control them - and we lost. And now they do what we built them to do: fight a war against us, without end.

Metal Apex: Rogue Prototype is a turn-based tactical game where every move is a battle of wits against a ruthless, aggressive AI. Inspired by Advance Wars and X-COM, it challenges you to adapt, strategize, and outmaneuver an opponent that presses every advantage and punishes every mistake.

           

Turn-based, Grid-based, Tactical Combat

Every battle in Metal Apex: Rogue Prototype is a high-stakes test of strategy and adaptability. Your ability to read the battlefield and make calculated decisions will determine your success:

  • Master the Terrain - Use roads for speed, forests for cover, and cities for both. And protect your base - losing it means defeat.

  • Allocate Unit Energy - Unit "Weapon," "Sensor," and "Engine" systems require power to function. Allocate energy among those systems to change unit characteristics on-the-fly and meet battlefield demands.

  • Lock on Target - Attack enemy Weapon, Sensor, and Engine systems to weaken firepower, disrupt targeting, or cripple mobility.

  • Merge & Regroup - Merge damaged units to recover strength and stay in the fight.

  • Survive - A unit's energy is also its health. When it reaches zero, the unit explodes.

          

Key Features

  • Ruthless AI - No enemy spam. The AI will beat you in a fair fight.

  • Adjustable Difficulty - Is the AI too strong? Lower the difficulty and enjoy the story.

  • Short Learning-Curve - Simple mechanics that are easy to learn, but difficult to master. No lengthy tutorials required.

  • Up-Tempo Pacing - Enjoy brisk close-quarters combat on single-screen maps.

  • 10+ Missions - A gripping linear single-player campaign.

  • Local 2-Player PvP - Challenge a friend in head-to-head battle.

  • Steam Deck Compatibility - Plays beautifully on the Steam Deck.

Experience the Future of Gaming: PICO-8

Metal Apex: Rogue Prototype is built on PICO-8 - a cutting-edge fantasy console delivering state-of-the-art technology:

  • High-Definition 128x128 Pixel Display

  • Stunning 16-Color Palette

  • Massive 32 Kilobyte Cartridge

  • Rich 4-Channel Stereo Sound

Metal Apex: Rogue Prototype packs massive strategic depth into a tiny console. Take command, outthink the AI, and prove that humanity isn't obsolete!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: 700 Mhz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: METAL APEX: Rogue Prototype should run well on nearly any machine.
